name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Opus Builders offer on renovation work?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Opus Builders offer on renovation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opus Builders stands behind the quality of our luxury renovation work with a comprehensive warranty on craftsmanship and structural integrity. Specific warranty details are outlined in our project contracts, typically covering a period of one to two years for labor and materials, though certain components may carry longer manufacturer warranties. We are committed to addressing any issues that may arise post-completion promptly and efficiently, ensuring your satisfaction and the lasting quality of your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opus Builders offers a comprehensive warranty on craftsmanship and structural integrity for our renovation work, typically one to two years for labor and materials.
